notes: Main disagreements: (1) actor, in the university guidelines B coded nearly every community-wide principle as admin where A coded all; resolved to all when the sentence binds users or members of the community, and admin only where the university itself acts (vetted tools, review cycle, how the policy was made). (2) phase, general vs a course stage for rationale and background statements inside the CELT sample syllabus statements (A course-start, B general); resolved to general when the sentence is rationale, definition or principle and not tied to a stage. (3) policy_type, e.g. P04 vs P09 for assignment-level directions (P04), P07 vs P61 for the definition of generative AI (P61 with a fit_note for embedded features), P04 vs P56 for the guidelines being non-prescriptive (P56), P77 vs P78 for compliance with school and unit policies (P77), P43 and UNCOVERED for the reasons given for a ban and for equal grading of users and non-users, and P27 vs P24 for quotation marks and attribution (P27, also applied to the unit both coders had coded P24 for consistency). (4) unit_stance, require/restrict vs neutral/permit: disclosure, privacy and own-work duties are conditions on permitted use, so neutral or permit, and flat items in a 'Not permitted' list are prohibit. (5) modality, informs vs should/must, resolved by whether the sentence states a rule or a benefit. Units found by one coder: A split some compound sentences into separate rules (the privacy and intellectual property list, the list of required acknowledgment contents, student vs consult-the-instructor) and these were kept as distinct rules (12 kept of 14 only_A); the two dropped were a faculty anecdote quote (Can we come to a single, consensus class policy) and a link to a blog post. B-only units (6, all kept) were a dated no-institution-policy statement from a course sample, the definition of generative AI, a benefit statement, an own-effort rule, an accuracy warning, and a pointer to the TTS data guidance. A few mis-paired units from automatic alignment (e.g. B's merged student disclosure and consult unit, three list items) were re-paired by passage. Shares are over matched units (the A unit that was a split of a B unit is counted as only_A). Stance agreed on both documents (delegates).
